critical_compatibility_rules: Harmonic damper and flywheel/flexplate MUST be 0 oz internal/neutral balance.
NO fuel pump eccentric is installed; mechanical fuel pump requires pulling timing cover to add eccentric (and carb-boss cover if current Fox cover lacks boss).
Power steering pump MUST be 1,100 PSI low-flow (e.g., valved Type-II/Saginaw) to match Unisteer UNI-8010830-01 rack.
Distributor gear MUST be compatible with billet steel hydraulic roller camshaft.
Front wheels MUST be 17-inch or larger (and verified with SOT fitment template) to clear SOT-13X125-2PC-4P-ALUM-LEADING 13" brakes.
Rear 9" axle housing MUST have Torino (Big Ford New-Style) bearing ends to fit ST-12BKR-T rear brakes.
Brakes use a 1" bore manual tandem master cylinder (WIL-261-15544-BK) — no vacuum booster required.
Oil pan Moroso 20535 is front-sump (8" deep, passenger kickout) — verify clearance with Unisteer UNI-8010830-01 rack; requires universal passenger-side pan dipstick.
AFR 1381 heads have angle plugs and 0.125" raised exhaust ports — verify header & spark plug boot clearance with shock towers and Unisteer/IDIDIT steering shaft.
Trick Flow 1.6 roller rockers require tall/cleared perimeter-bolt valve covers.
Edelbrock 7521 Air-Gap has a 4.90" carb pad height — verify 1967 Shelby hood and SOT-QRSTB Monte Carlo bar clearance.
Rear axle is 1964-66 Mustang width (2" narrower than 1967) with Mustangs to Fear mini-tubs moved to frame rails — account for narrower WMS-to-WMS when calculating rear wheel backspacing.
Rear axle uses 31-spline shafts and 1/2"-20 x 3" studs (requires open-ended lug nuts) — 9" third member MUST be 31-spline.

Holley Mid-Mount SBF accessory drive requires grinding designated timing-cover wall + Holley 97-436 PS relocation kit + remote reservoir to run BOTH a mechanical fuel pump and power steering, plus fuel pump eccentric and 0 oz damper spacer check.
Modern Driveline TKX kit flywheel MUST be 0 oz neutral balance.
Cobra solid block-letter valve covers must be clay-checked for clearance over Trick Flow 1.6 roller rockers and internal oil baffles.
